canonical_project: Davis Road Data Centre, Wetherill Park
notes: NSW Planning Portal lists SSD-59416728, Davis Road Data Centre (Cundall), in Fairfield City for two data centre buildings with overall power consumption of 180 MW; decision approved with determination date 2024-12-20. NSW Government's 2026 IDA release names Stockland's 2 Davis Road, Wetherill Park project in Fairfield.
